blocks.text:
City tour and excursion to Sugarloaf (4h) with an English-speaking guide.

We go to Praia Vermelha (red beach). From there,  you will take a special cable car  to the top of Sugarloaf Mountain. The first stop will be on Mount Urca, which has a wide viewpoint. On Sugarloaf Mountain itself, there is a smaller platform, but it offers a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, islands in the ocean, the bridge to the city of Niterói,  a statue of Christ.

Then you will go to the central districts of old Rio, where you will admire several ancient churches, monasteries, the main Cathedral of the city, as well as buildings built in the colonial style.

*Due to the congestion of the city due to the  New Year holidays, the route of the city tour may be adjusted.
